# Robert Allen Bautista

> Plain-English tax tips for Kansas City freelancers, gig workers and small business owners. Robert Allen Bautista: M.S. in Accounting, former PwC, CPA candidate, author of The Small Business Tax Code, Unlocked and The Small Business Tax Calendar. As quoted in Homes.com, Stonebridge Herald & Gigs Magazine.

- [Free Tax Help in Kansas City and Lawrence for the 2027 Filing Season: VITA, AARP Tax-Aide, Clinics and IRS Free File](https://robertallenbautista.com/articles/free-tax-help-kansas-city-lawrence-vita-free-file/): Where to find free tax help for 2027 in Kansas City and Lawrence: VITA, TCE, AARP Tax-Aide, IRS Free File, MilTax and tax clinics, by Robert Allen Bautista.
- [2027 Tax Brackets and Standard Deduction: What Changes for Your 2027 Paycheck](https://robertallenbautista.com/articles/2027-tax-brackets-standard-deduction-what-changes/): The IRS 2027 tax brackets and standard deduction by filing status, with a worked example and what to check on your paycheck, by Robert Allen Bautista.
- [2027 Contribution Limits: 401(k), IRA, HSA and the Social Security Wage Base](https://robertallenbautista.com/articles/2027-contribution-limits-401k-ira-hsa-social-security-wage-base/): The IRS and SSA 2027 limits for 401(k), IRA, HSA and the Social Security wage base, with sources and what each one means, by Robert Allen Bautista.
- [Freelancer Planning for 2027: Estimated Tax Dates and Safe Harbors](https://robertallenbautista.com/articles/2027-estimated-tax-dates-freelancers-kansas-city/): The four 2027 estimated tax due dates, how weekends and holidays shift them, safe harbor rules and the Kansas City earnings tax, by Robert Allen Bautista.
